facts.text: I used an ExtraTreesClassifier for groundwater quality classification for irrigation purposes.
My model achieved an accuracy of 90.62%.
My model achieved an F1 score of 90.20%.
I used 6 physiochemical parameters as inputs out of 22 before feature selection.
My abstract title for a conference was "Comparison of the ensemble algorithms with the multiple layer perceptron for classification of groundwater quality."
My abstract compared ensemble algorithms with a multiple layer perceptron (MLP) for classification of groundwater quality.
My abstract used tabular data representing groundwater water quality parameters for classification purposes.
My abstract evaluated machine learning algorithms using accuracy and F1 score as evaluation metrics.
My abstract reported ExtraTreesClassifier accuracy of 90.62% and F1 score of 90.20%.
My abstract reported RandomForestClassifier accuracy of 89.72% and F1 score of 89.56%.
My abstract reported Multiple Layer Perceptron (MLP) accuracy of 86.29% and F1 score of 85.72%.
My abstract concluded that ensemble algorithms performed better than the artificial neural network on tabular data.
